cases.title: A higher bill deserves a closer look.
cases.summary: Follow the proposed gas-rate increase from the headline to the source documents, then make your voice part of the process.

revenue.note: 2027 is the utility’s expected baseline, not a final audited collection. Later years add SEC-disclosed increments rounded to millions. These are annual revenue levels, not household bill forecasts or cumulative collections.

composition.note: Composition of the whole 2028 request, not the additional $485 million. Return includes debt financing and equity returns; it is not all shareholder profit.

comments.method: Manual reading of pagination total. Entries may include repeat commenters or removed entries. No personal information is republished.

related.note: The applications are consolidated, but comment lists are separate. SDG&E figures do not describe SoCalGas bills.

demands.title: Explain every additional dollar.
demands.description: Publish a reconciliation of the proposed $485 million increase by operating costs, depreciation, taxes and capital returns.
demands.request: Publish a complete reconciliation of the additional $485 million, separating operating costs, depreciation, taxes and returns on capital.

demands.title: Show the less expensive options.
demands.description: Compare major investments with credible alternatives and measurable benefits for customers.
demands.request: Require independent scrutiny of major investments, competitive procurement and comparisons with less expensive alternatives.

demands.title: Show the whole bill impact.
demands.description: Assess this case alongside other pending requests, across household usage levels and through 2031.
demands.request: Publish the combined household impact of this application and other pending cost-recovery requests through 2031.

evidence.title: $485 million more requested for 2028
evidence.summary: The hearing notice describes a 10.5% revenue increase. This is the company’s request; approval is pending.

evidence.title: The request continues through 2031
evidence.summary: Sempra discloses additional annual increments of $315m, $312m and $314m for 2029, 2030 and 2031.

evidence.title: Capital returns are part of the revenue requirement
evidence.summary: Table RH-1 includes $1.349bn in total capital returns. This includes financing costs and is not a measure of shareholder profit.

evidence.title: What drives each part of the increase?
evidence.summary: The overall cost composition is not a category-by-category explanation of the increase. A comparable baseline reconciliation still needs review.

evidence.title: Public comments and formal evidence have different roles
evidence.summary: Community participation can surface concerns. A formal challenge also needs evidence and participation under the CPUC’s rules.

evidence.title: What would all pending requests cost together?
evidence.summary: A reviewed inventory of other applications and a combined customer impact analysis have not yet been added to this project.
